name: Hotel Vivera (Bhongir Bypass)
signature_dish: South Indian Udupi meals and Punjabi dishes
why_it_matters: The best-known highway restaurant at Bhongir — on the Hyderabad-Warangal highway near the toll plaza, two facing Vivera units busy with families all day. It runs an Udupi section for South Indian meals plus a Punjabi menu, and an AC dining hall, making it the standard road-meal halt near Bhongir Fort and Yadagirigutta.
insider_tip: Two Vivera hotels face each other across the highway — either works. The constant family turnover means food is fresh through the day. A practical first or last stop on a Bhongir Fort plus Yadadri day trip from Hyderabad.
signature_address: NH-163, Bypass Road, Bhongir, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana 508286

name: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple Nitya Annadanam (Yadadri)
why_it_matters: The Nitya Annadanam at the Yadadri (Yadagirigutta) Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple — the major pilgrimage hill about 15km from Bhongir. Running since 1989, the scheme serves a free vegetarian lunch to around 500 devotees daily on average, rising to 1,000-plus on festival days; daily footfall for the free lunch reaches roughly 2,000. A mechanised prasadam unit was added to keep pace.
insider_tip: Free lunch is served 11am-3pm — go straight after morning darshan. The temple also sells laddu, pulihora and vada prasadam at nominal prices at the counter. Bhongir Fort and Yadadri are usually combined on one day trip; eat the annadanam at the temple.
signature_address: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Devasthanam, Yadagirigutta, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana 508115

name: Haritha Hotel Restaurant (TGTDC Yadagirigutta)
why_it_matters: The restaurant at the Telangana tourism (TSTDC) Haritha hotel in Yadagirigutta — about 270m from the Yadadri temple. Open 7am-11pm, it is the most dependable sit-down meal near the temple for pilgrims who want a proper restaurant rather than the annadanam queue or theme-park stalls.
insider_tip: An 8-minute walk from the temple, so handy for an early breakfast before darshan or a late dinner after. Standard Haritha multi-cuisine menu. Walk-in.
signature_address: Haritha Hotel, near Narasimha Swamy Temple, Prahalagutta, Yadagirigutta, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana 508115

name: Red Bucket Biryani (Bhuvanagiri)
why_it_matters: The Bhuvanagiri (Bhongir town) outlet of Red Bucket Biryani — a well-known Telangana biryani brand. With chicken, mutton, egg, fish and prawn biryanis and a wide takeaway base on Swiggy and Zomato, it is the dependable biryani option in Bhongir town itself, near the fort.
insider_tip: Biryani is the whole menu — the chicken and mutton are the safe picks; the seafood biryanis are the less-expected order. Strong takeaway operation if you want to carry food up to a Bhongir Fort viewpoint. Walk-in.
signature_address: Ganj Main Road, Bhuvanagiri town, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana 508116

name: Surendrapuri Theme Park Food Stalls
area: Surendrapuri Mythological Theme Park, near Yadagirigutta
signature_dish: Snacks and basic meals inside the theme park
why_it_matters: Surendrapuri — India's first mythological theme park, near Yadagirigutta and a common add-on to a Bhongir trip — has food stalls throughout the grounds serving snacks, cold drinks and basic meals to visitors. A dedicated food court is still under development, so the stalls are the in-park option.
insider_tip: The stalls cover snacks and refreshments but not a serious meal — carry water in summer, and plan a proper lunch at the Haritha hotel or Vivera. A practical option only while you are inside the park.
signature_address: Surendrapuri Mythological Theme Park, near Yadagirigutta, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District, Telangana 508115
